scope: One response-unopened methodological triage of two previously published metapopulation sources, not a search for favorable outcomes

sources.metadata_statement: Published methods: 15 ring patches, seven independent metapopulations per assigned short/occasional-long distance treatment; experimental sampling in two time blocks; 10% equal overall dispersal 3 times weekly; long-distance day-specific destination pattern was SHARED across all replicate metapopulations on that day
limits: Fourteen independently assigned metapopulations do not equal 210 independent patch-level experimental units
The seven long-distance metapopulations share a daily dispersal realization; seven do not mean seven independent daily route maps
The 2019 article already established increased prey synchrony under occasional long-distance dispersal
The physical destination map for every observed source-to-target event has not been verified in the published source files
Predator below-detection sampling may conflate temporary non-detection with local extinction

sources.metadata_statement: Data synthesis of 22 experiments and 16 unique network structures including previously published Holyoak 1996/2000, four metacommunity replicates per experiment, patch-level predator/prey trajectories sampled 3x/week for >=75 days, fixed tubes linking patches
limits: Twenty-two experiments are not 22 entirely new/independent published-source lineages because the synthesis includes Holyoak 1996/2000
Eighty-eight potential metacommunity replicates are not 88 independent network architectures
Connection of patches by fixed tubing is a physical graph, not a direct measurement of realized directed migration
The original synthesis already reported network connectivity/synchrony and predator/prey occupancy relationships
Exact source study IDs, time-ordered transitions, species detection, and independent estimable heldout groups have not been audited

future_target.ecological_fork: Does source availability aid future 0->1 colonization while correlated loss of functioning donors negates the benefit, conditional on environment and geometry?
future_target.primary: Lagged guild-specific occupied/viable donor state and independent directional transport add heldout next-interval 0->1 log-loss information beyond a strong lagged occupancy, prey, habitat, effort, and nearest-source reference
future_target.secondary: 1->0 local loss and complete donor cofailure modelled separately; do not combine with primary 0->1
future_target.third_order: Higher-order simultaneous donor loss must be measured as joint state across sources, not inferred solely from pairwise source synchrony
future_target.note: The source redundancy hypothesis and synchrony mechanism are already known in the literature; incremental independent prediction is the testable remaining claim

gate_contract.independent_unit: metapopulation experimental replicate; if testing operator portability hold out whole independently distinct network/realization units rather than patches
gate_contract.before_pilot: Replay current Structural v0.10/v0.11 then freeze v0.31 disjoint burned pilot / confirmatory and v0.42 response quality on same fingerprint
